metadata.method_name: screen-C mechanism ablation of the phase-aware power-flow kernel
metadata.description: Partly. At n=80 the output-restricted GP kernel on the analytic operator's coordinates reaches 0.0340 normalised RMSE against 0.0911 for plain ridge on the same coordinates and 0.0223 for a FIXED degree-2 polynomial map in those coordinates. The GP's paired relative advantage over the purely linear arm is +188.5% (sign test p=1.19e-07, 24/24 folds) -- so the GP is NOT decoration. But the fixed quadratic feature map matches or beats it, so the kernel itself is not the active ingredient: what the kernel contributes is the quadratic (second-order) structure in the operator's coordinates, which explicit degree-2 features reproduce without a kernel. Verdict class V3.
metadata.verdict_one_line: The nonlinearity is real but NOT kernel-specific: a fixed degree-2 polynomial feature map in the operator's coordinates (quad_S45) matches or beats the output-restricted GP kernel at n=80 while the purely linear arms fall short.
metadata.dataset: IEEE European LV asymmetric feeder, 55 single-phase loads on their real phases, 2.0x loading, 220 archived runpp_3ph AC solves
metadata.targets: 15 far-end buses x phases (a,b,c) = 45 per-unit voltage magnitudes
metadata.features: 110 = P (55 loads) then Q (55 loads), never reordered
metadata.fold_recipe: n in {10,20,40,80,160}; 12 seeds x 2 partition schemes; 24 folds per size, 12 at n=160
metadata.normalisation_denominator: mean per-output sd on the TRAIN rows (primary)
metadata.scope_limits: ONE feeder (IEEE European LV, 55 single-phase loads on their real phases). This supports a MECHANISM claim, not a generalisation claim.; ONE loading regime (2.0x, 114.7 kW mean active load). The 1.0x and 2.6x regimes are archived but RESERVED as the survivor's independent confirmation evidence in a later iteration, so no regime-independence claim is made here.; NO neural-network baseline. The artifact compares the GP against linear models and calibrated physics on identical features; it cannot claim the operator basis beats a learned nonlinear surrogate. A DNN comparison is named as deferred work.; The linear model on Sx is STILL A LINEAR MODEL IN THE INJECTIONS, because Sx is linear in x. The claim under test is therefore about conditioning and effective dimension at fixed n, never about a richer function class.

ac_solves.note: no AC solve is run for any arm or for the operator; the 220 archived solves are the ground truth

examples.input: Predict the 45 far-end per-unit voltage magnitudes (15 buses x phases a,b,c) of the IEEE European LV feeder at 2.0x loading (mean active load 114.69 kW) for 210 held-out lognormal household injection draws, after training on 10 converged runpp_3ph AC solves. Fold n10_s0_c0 (seed 0, partition scheme 0).
examples.output: GP kernel on the analytic operator's coordinates: normalised far-end RMSE 0.3730507507. Ridge on the same coordinates 0.1251850193. Degree-2 polynomial in the same coordinates not_reported. Best of five baselines 0.1286649058 (b5_lindist).
